meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin par **white cast se bachne ke liye chemical ya mostly-chemical sunscreen** choose karein—mineral filters, jaise zinc oxide/titanium dioxide, medium-to-deep skin tones par cast chhod sakte hain.[2][3]

**Best overall recommendation:** **Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**  
- Lightweight, generally no visible white cast  
- Fragrance-free option  
- Normal, combination aur oily skin ke liye achha daily sunscreen[4][8]

**Skin type ke hisaab se alternatives:**
- **Oily/acne-prone:** Dot & Key Waterlight Gel SPF 50 ya Minimalist SPF 50[4]
- **Dry/normal:** Bioderma Photoderm Max ya PHD Panthenol Hydrating Gel SPF 60 PA++++[3][4]
- **Tinted option:** Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50—tint white cast ko effectively hide karta hai.[1]
- **Budget option:** Plum SPF 50 PA++++, jise lightweight aur no-white-cast formula ke roop mein list kiya gaya hai.[7]

**Kaise lagayein:** Broad-spectrum **SPF 50, PA++++** lein; face aur neck par lagbhag **do-finger amount** lagayein aur outdoor exposure mein har 2 ghante reapply karein.[3] Kharidne se pehle jawline par natural daylight mein patch-test zaroor karein, kyunki deeper skin tones par product ka finish alag dikh sakta hai.[4]
